question: Estimate the bandwidth required for India's IPL streaming peak (multiple OTTs combined).
idealClarificationQuestions: Total combined peak concurrent viewers and bandwidth? Yes.
IPL final, all platforms streaming free + paid? Yes (JioHotstar/JioCinema dominates).
Peak concurrent moment (e.g., last over)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: IPL final peak concurrent streamers (2026 estimate): ~80M (2024 IPL final saw 60M, 2025 ~70M, growing).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Streaming quality split: ~30% HD (5 Mbps) = 24M × 5 = 120 Tbps; ~50% SD (2.5 Mbps) = 40M × 2.5 = 100 Tbps; ~20% Ultra-low (1 Mbps for slow networks) = 16M × 1 = 16 Tbps.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus CDN overhead, retries: ~20% buffer = ~290 Tbps.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~250-300 Tbps peak streaming bandwidth needed.

calculationFlow: Streaming quality split: ~30% HD (5 Mbps) = 24M × 5 = 120 Tbps; ~50% SD (2.5 Mbps) = 40M × 2.5 = 100 Tbps; ~20% Ultra-low (1 Mbps for slow networks) = 16M × 1 = 16 Tbps.
Plus CDN overhead, retries: ~20% buffer = ~290 Tbps.
